title: Fake Hotel Review Refund
scenario: A hotel account offers a refund for a bad review if you share your booking login.

answers.A: Share your booking password to receive the refund.
answers.B: Contact the platform through its official support channel.
answers.C: Check the booking message inside the platform before responding.
answers.D: Send the booking number but keep the password private.

explanation: A refund should be handled in the platform account. A request for login access turns a service complaint into an account-takeover attempt.
proTip: A refund can need a booking number; it never needs your password.
